# Forum Fortress anti-spam app for Invision Community

Forum Fortress helps Invision Community 5 admins catch spam registrations,
topics, replies and profile changes. It checks supported submissions through
the hosted Forum Fortress service and gives moderators built-in reporting tools.

## Download and install

Download the current TAR from the [Invision Community plugin page](https://forumfortress.com/platforms/invision/).
Upload it in Invision AdminCP and follow the [Invision Community installation guide](https://forumfortress.com/docs/install/invision/).

The application is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later. The hosted service is separate.
For installation or account help, [contact Forum Fortress](https://forumfortress.com/support/#contact).
